from pathlib import Path
import json,pandas as pd,hashlib
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_three_cause_weekly_score_v1'
paths=['result.json','saved_models.json','全部训练叶成员.csv','全部固定高分机会.csv']
reg={'registered_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'scope':'全部已保存固定高分叶，不改变模型、预测、样本或账户准入；只归因训练成员',
 'input_hashes':{n:hashlib.sha256((out/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in paths},'statistics':['叶样本数','最大正标签及正收益合计占比','最大正标签带符号合计占比','实际路径字段'],'new_fits':0}
(out/'高分来源归因_registration.json').write_text(json.dumps(reg,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
leaf=pd.read_csv(out/'全部训练叶成员.csv',dtype={'prediction_event_id':str,'training_event_id':str})
opp=pd.read_csv(out/'全部固定高分机会.csv',dtype={'event_id':str})
records=[]
for r in opp.itertuples():
    members=leaf[leaf.model.eq(r.model)&leaf.prediction_event_id.eq(r.event_id)]
    positive=members[members.training_actual_net5.gt(0)]
    top=positive.loc[positive.training_actual_net5.idxmax()] if len(positive) else None
    signed=float(members.training_actual_net5.sum());possum=float(positive.training_actual_net5.sum())
    records.append({'model':r.model,'event_id':r.event_id,'era':r.era,'entry_date':r.entry_date,'exit_date':r.exit_date,
        'net_return':r.net_return,'prediction':r.prediction,'score':r.score,'actual_path_fields':r.actual_path_fields,
        'cause_on_actual_path':r.cause_on_actual_path,'leaf_members':len(members),'leaf_positive_members':len(positive),
        'leaf_mean_net5':float(members.training_actual_net5.mean()),'largest_positive_training_event':top.training_event_id if top is not None else None,
        'largest_positive_entry_date':top.training_entry_date if top is not None else None,'largest_positive_exit_date':top.training_exit_date if top is not None else None,
        'largest_positive_net5':float(top.training_actual_net5) if top is not None else None,
        'largest_positive_share_of_positive_sum':float(top.training_actual_net5/possum) if top is not None and possum>0 else None,
        'largest_positive_share_of_signed_sum':float(top.training_actual_net5/signed) if top is not None and abs(signed)>1e-12 else None,
        'leaf_replay_error':abs(float(members.training_actual_net5.mean())-r.prediction)})
df=pd.DataFrame(records);assert df.leaf_replay_error.max()<1e-12
assert all(hashlib.sha256((out/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for n,h in reg['input_hashes'].items())
df.to_csv(out/'全部高分叶来源归因.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
print('全部高分叶：',len(df),'；主期联合：')
print(df[df.model.eq('joint')&df.era.eq('2024—2025')].to_string(index=False))
print('逐年固定机会：');print(pd.read_csv(out/'高分机会逐年次数.csv').to_string(index=False))
print('主期五档：');print(pd.read_csv(out/'同事件全部五档比较.csv').query('era == "2024—2025"').to_string(index=False))
